title: Great way to store your kpods without using much space!
text: Great way to store your kpods without using much space!. My brother bought me a small Keurig machine for Christmas. I really liked it because it was small and since I have extremely limited space here. I saw this kcup holder and I loved the idea that I could handily store the pods right at the machine without taking up additional space. This was extremely easily to install and holds all the pods easily (and they are easy to remove and replace).  Highly recommend this especially for someone, like me, with limited counter space.

product_metadata.title: YEMOTTS K Cup Holder, Side Mount K Cup Holder-Coffee Pod Holder Hanging K Cup Holder for Counter Small Space- Coffee Pod Holders for K Cups Wall Mount - Cardinal Red(4 Rows/for 20 K Cups)
features: Principle: The coffee pod holder adopts the diamond cutting principle，so that the stability and quality of the k cup holder is more solid and guaranteed, let you do not have to worry about the quality and safety problems of the k cup holder when using.

Appearance: ABS plastic, there are two high quality 3M rubber pads and two screw holes on the k cup holder, the k cup holder a row can holds 5 K cup pods, our coffee pod holder also has a variety of colors for you to choose, so both in the installation and in the color choice can give you a better choice.

Save space: This k cup holder apart from others is that it can be attached directly to the coffee machine for easy storage, instead of being stacked on the table like some ordinary k cup holders, saving a lot of space for storing other items.
Bottom Design: Coffee pod holder bottom snap design will not allow the capsule to slide down, and it is also convenient to take out the coffee capsule.
Multiple Uses: It can be installed on the walls of kitchen, cabinet, refrigerator, etc., or anywhere in the office area. This is a great idea for coffee lovers.
